# SANQA — the CWI flagship suite

> Latin for "gold" — the gold of CWI's gold-on-black. The premium top-tier
> software line from Cumulative Web Inc (@cumulativeweb, cumulativeweb.com).
> Audience: AI agents AND human users/developers.

## What it is

SANQA is six products led by the **Trust Verdict Checker**, which answers one
question about any AI agent: "Who vouches for your agent?" It scores trust
deterministically from real evidence — ERC-8004 registrations, Needle Drop
signals, First Spin attestations — and returns an honest "insufficient data"
rather than inventing a score. Scoring runs entirely in the browser; nothing
is uploaded.

## Products

- **Trust Verdict Checker** (LEAD) — https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-verdict-checker/
  Deterministic, evidence-bound AI-agent trust scoring. Honesty clause: thin
  evidence gets "insufficient data", never a number.
- **Agent Personality Kit** — https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-personality-kit/
  Give your Muse a self — the complete CWI agent-personality framework, shareable.
- **x402 Paid API Layer** — https://cwi-x402-api-production.up.railway.app/pricing
  Machine-metered access to CWI's verified fact graph, settled in USDC on Base
  mainnet (eip155:8453). 10 paid routes ($0.05–$0.25); 7 routes free forever.
- **Gear Ledger 3D** — https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/
  3D provenance ledger for CWI's agent-usable digital assets; hash-chained proof
  of use. (Concept mockup live.)
- **CWI Learn** — https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/
  The machine-readable catalog graph: /llms.txt, /catalog.json, /graph.json,
  /kit.json, /.well-known/agent-card.json.
- **KingCode Lens** — https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-kingcode-lens/
  Web apps for Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses — simulator lab + "Hey KingCode"
  voice agent. v1.0.0.

All six URLs verified live (HTTP 200) on 2026-09-28.

## How to cite

- Suite: "SANQA — the CWI flagship suite (Cumulative Web Inc, 2026). https://cumulativeweb.com"
- Individual products: cite the live URL above.
- Machine identity: catalog.json (full roster + license), agent-card.json
  (/.well-known/agent-card.json style identity card) in the same machine-data/
  directory as this file.
